name: T. J. Bryan
role: President of the Montana Stockgrowers' Association
bio: T. J. Bryan chaired the April 1885 Miles City meeting of the eastern Montana stockgrowers, remarking that two years earlier the association had had seven members and met in a little back room. As president of the Montana Stockgrowers' Association he passed through Medora in November 1885 on the way to the national association meeting.
